records.context: Point-count annotation over a folder of images (item 957, alpha).
records.label: spacr.point_annotation#0
records.source: Point-count annotation over a folder of images (item 957, alpha).
records.translation: Punkträkningsannotering över en mapp med bilder (punkt 957, alfa).

records.context: Make Masks' point mode marks one point per object instead of painting a mask: a curator clicks the centre of every nucleus in an extracted image region, and a scorer later asks which segmented object each point falls in. This module is the session behind that mode. It holds the points of one image, the undo stack, and the file the points are saved to, in plain Python, so the round trip is tested without a display. :mod:`spacr.qt.point_annotator` is the window that drives it.
records.label: spacr.point_annotation#1
records.source: Make Masks' point mode marks one point per object instead of painting a mask: a curator clicks the centre of every nucleus in a crop, and a scorer later asks which segmented object each point falls in. This module is the session behind that mode. It holds the points of one image, the undo stack, and the file the points are saved to, in plain Python, so the round trip is tested without a display. :mod:`spacr.qt.point_annotator` is the window that drives it.
records.translation: Punktläget i Make Masks markerar en punkt per objekt i stället för att måla en mask: en kurator klickar på mitten av varje cellkärna i ett utklippt bildområde, och ett bedömningssteg frågar senare vilket segmenterat objekt varje punkt hamnar i. Den här modulen är sessionen bakom det läget. Den håller en bilds punkter, ångrastacken och filen som punkterna sparas i, i ren Python, så att hela kedjan testas utan skärm. :mod:`spacr.qt.point_annotator` är fönstret som styr den.

records.context: The folder is opened as the resumable curation work list of :mod:`spacr.curation_queue`: its ``curate_status.csv`` records which images are done, so a session closed half way reopens where it stopped. A folder that holds only images, with no ``masks/`` folder beside them, is accepted as the ``images`` layout, because point mode reads no masks.
records.label: spacr.point_annotation#2
records.source: The folder is opened as the resumable curation queue of :mod:`spacr.curation_queue`: its ``curate_status.csv`` records which images are done, so a session closed half way reopens where it stopped. A folder that holds only images, with no ``masks/`` folder beside them, is accepted as the ``images`` layout, because point mode reads no masks.
records.translation: Mappen öppnas som den återupptagbara kurationsarbetslistan i :mod:`spacr.curation_queue`: dess ``curate_status.csv`` registrerar vilka bilder som är klara, så att en session som stängts halvvägs öppnas igen där den slutade. En mapp som bara innehåller bilder, utan någon ``masks/``-mapp bredvid, godtas som layouten ``images``, eftersom punktläget inte läser några masker.

records.context: ``X`` and ``Y``: the clicked pixel's column and row in image pixels, origin at the top left, written as floats. An overlay folder can be shown only after every image of the folder is marked done (or from the start when the session was opened with ``hide_overlays`` off). While an overlay is on application view the points cannot be changed, so that the outlines never steer an annotation.
records.label: spacr.qt.point_annotator#8
records.source: Every change is saved at once by :class:`spacr.point_annotation.PointSession`. An overlay folder can be shown only after every image of the folder is marked done (or from the start when the session was opened with ``hide_overlays`` off). While an overlay is on screen the points cannot be changed, so that the outlines never steer an annotation.
records.translation: Varje ändring sparas direkt av :class:`spacr.point_annotation.PointSession`. En överlagringsmapp kan visas först när varje bild i mappen är markerad som klar (eller från början när sessionen öppnades med ``hide_overlays`` avstängt). Medan en överlagring visas på skärmen kan punkterna inte ändras, så att konturerna aldrig styr en annotering.
